title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Multiplication Step
statement: For a bit string $S$, apply the following update: if the first component of the second component decoded from $S$ is empty, return $S$; otherwise form a new encoded pair whose first component is $0$ followed by the first decoded component of $S$, and whose second component encodes the tail and first bit of the first component decoded from the second component of $S$, together with either the sum of the second decoded component of that inner pair and the first decoded component of $S$ when that first bit is $1$, or the remaining second decoded component otherwise. This update function is polynomial-time computable.
